complex-treatments.label: Complex treatments
complex-treatments.summary: Causal questions that go beyond two treatment options.
complex-treatments.title: Causal estimation with complex exposures
complex-treatments.body: Methods for estimating causal effects of treatments with multiple levels or complex exposures within the potential outcomes framework. We combine doubly robust estimation, cross-fitting and influence-function-based inference, including when nuisance models are estimated with machine learning. The Software section includes the tmleMulti implementation.

targeted-learning.label: Targeted learning
targeted-learning.summary: Connecting flexible statistical learning with causal estimation.
targeted-learning.title: Targeted learning & semiparametric efficiency
targeted-learning.body: Methods that combine statistical learning with causal estimation, including targeted maximum likelihood estimation (TMLE) and doubly robust approaches. Semiparametric efficiency theory, influence functions and the delta method provide a basis for inference and variance estimation.

conformal-inference.label: Conformal inference
conformal-inference.summary: Exploring uncertainty at the intersection of prediction and causality.
conformal-inference.title: Conformal inference for causal questions
conformal-inference.body: Conformal methods for quantifying uncertainty in causal estimands, including settings that use machine learning or have small samples. We investigate the assumptions and conditions under which finite-sample coverage can be guaranteed.

population-health.label: Population health
population-health.summary: Epidemiological methods for health outcomes and inequalities.
population-health.title: Computational epidemiology & inequalities in cancer
population-health.body: Applications of causal inference and computational epidemiology to population health. Topics include socioeconomic inequalities in cancer outcomes, emergency presentation and cancer survival, and reproducible, data-adaptive estimation.
